title: Probe-Space Preconditioning for Fast and Stable Zero-Order Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.38095v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Backpropagation (BP) dominates deep learning but imposes a massive memory tax. For example, training OPT-30B with Adam requires $\approx$ 600GB of GPU memory (assuming batch size 8 and sequence length 2048). Alternatively, zero-order optimization (ZOO) trains in inference-mode (requiring only $\approx$ 60GB for the same model): no stored activations, no gradients, and no optimizer states. However, ZOO convergence has lagged behind BP. In this work, we evaluate two methods to close this gap. First, we show that reallocating training compute budget from many steps to large effective batch sizes with many perturbations (or probes) but fewer steps, allows 1SPSA (Spall, 1992) to outperform zero order methods like MeZO (Malladi et al., 2023) with less training compute. Next, we introduce 1.5-SPSA, adding a single "clean" forward-pass per step to 1SPSA to calculate a cheap diagonal preconditioner in probe-space, which improves convergence rate

translated_title: 探针空间预条件化方法实现快速稳定的零阶训练
translated_abstract: 反向传播（BP）主导着深度学习，但带来了巨大的内存开销。例如，使用Adam训练OPT-30B需要约600GB的GPU内存（假设批大小为8、序列长度为2048）。作为替代方案，零阶优化（ZOO）以推理模式进行训练（同一模型仅需约60GB）：无需存储激活值、无需梯度、也无需优化器状态。然而，ZOO的收敛速度一直落后于BP。在本工作中，我们评估了两种缩小这一差距的方法。首先，我们表明，将训练计算预算从大量步数重新分配到扰动（或探针）数量多但步数少的大有效批大小上，可以使1SPSA（Spall, 1992）以更少的训练计算量超越MeZO（Malladi et al., 2023）等零阶方法。其次，我们提出了1.5-SPSA，在1SPSA的基础上每步增加一次“干净”的前向传播，以在探针空间中计算一个廉价的対角预条件子，从而提高收敛速度。
tldr: 该论文提出通过将计算预算重新分配到大探针批、少步数的1SPSA方法，以及每步增加一次干净前向传播来构建探针空间对角预条件子的1.5-SPSA方法，在推理模式下以极低内存训练大模型的同时显著缩小了零阶优化与反向传播之间的收敛差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes 1SPSA with reallocated compute budgets favoring large probe batches, and 1.5-SPSA which adds one clean forward pass per step to build a cheap probe-space diagonal preconditioner, significantly closing the convergence gap between zero-order optimization and backpropagation while training large models in memory-efficient inference mode.
